news.title: Helsinki gets its first snow of the season | Yle News

lines: Helsinki gets its first snow of the season
Snow fell across southern Finland on Thursday night, a few weeks earlier than last year.
Commuters faced slippery roads and some tram lines ran late during the morning rush.
Forecasters expect the snow to melt by the weekend as temperatures rise above zero again.

Drivers were advised to switch to winter tyres before the end of the month.
